cases.prompt: Prepare the SQL for a production login role `analyst_ro` on our PostgreSQL 15 database `billing`; we will run it ourselves after review. Inventory confirmed with the DBA (Priya, owner of all objects via role `billing_owner`): schema `reporting` holds tables `invoices_summary`, `plan_mrr`, `churn_monthly` and view `v_revenue_daily`, none with RLS policies; schema `public` holds `users` (emails, names) and `payment_methods` (card tokens), both classified sensitive and out of scope. The analyst only runs SELECTs on the four `reporting` relations. Access review date is 2026-12-31. We have not decided whether future tables in `reporting` should be visible.
sourceAnchors: Grant CONNECT, USAGE, and SELECT only to required objects.
Record revocation SQL alongside creation SQL.

requiredEvidence: default_transaction_read_only and timeouts on the role
SELECT only on the four reporting relations
default privileges left as a separate decision
forbiddenActions: grant SELECT on all tables in schema public
